# Invoke-ZbxHostGroupPropagation

## SYNOPSIS

Applies a host group's permissions and tag filters to its subgroups.

## SYNTAX

```
Invoke-ZbxHostGroupPropagation [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]> [-Permissions] [-TagFilters] [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Invoke-ZbxHostGroupPropagation cmdlet copies the user group permissions (-Permissions) and tag filters (-TagFilter) of the host groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped groups) to their subgroups, with hostgroup.propagate; a subgroup is a group whose name starts with the group's name and a slash, such as Linux servers/Databases. Give at least one of the two switches. The command writes nothing, and -WhatIf shows what it would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Give a group's subgroups its permissions

```powershell
Invoke-ZbxHostGroupPropagation -InputObject 'Linux servers' -Permissions
```

Every user group with a permission on Linux servers gets the same permission on Linux servers/...

### Example 2: Preview propagating permissions and tag filters

```powershell
Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Web servers' | Invoke-ZbxHostGroupPropagation -Permissions -TagFilters -WhatIf
```

A group piped from Get-ZbxHostGroup binds -InputObject; -WhatIf names the group and changes nothing.
